hooks.command:
node -e "const p = (process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'); if (p.includes('/dist/') || p.includes('/build/')) { console.error('
🚫 STOP: ' + p + ' is a build artifact — do NOT edit it.
   Find the TypeScript source file and edit that instead.
   Build artifacts are overwritten on next compile.
'); process.exit(1); } const gen = ['services/dependency-graph.md','services/impact-analysis.md']; if (gen.some(g => p.endsWith(g))) { console.error('
🚫 STOP: ' + p + ' is auto-generated by npm run analyze:services — do NOT edit it directly.
'); process.exit(1); }"

node -e "const p = process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH || ''; const m = p.replace(/\\/g, '/').match(/services/([^/]+)//); if (m) { const fs = require('fs'); const r = 'services/' + m[1] + '/.claude/README.md'; if (fs.existsSync(r)) { console.error('
⚠️  PROCESS REMINDER: Read ' + r + ' before editing this service.
   Use the Read tool on that file first, then proceed.
'); } }"
bash -c 'p="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$p" | grep -qE ".(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|md)$"; then npx prettier --write "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'

node -e "const p = process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH || ''; const normalized = p.replace(/\\\\/g, '/'); if (normalized.includes('/simulation/') && !normalized.includes('/dist/') && !normalized.includes('/state/')) { try { require('child_process').execSync('npx tsc --noEmit --pretty 2>&1 | head -20', { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: require('path').join(process.cwd(), 'simulation') }); } catch(e) {} }"

node -e "const p = process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH || ''; const normalized = p.replace(/\\\\/g, '/'); if (normalized.includes('/services/') && !normalized.includes('/CONTEXT.md') && !normalized.includes('/.claude/') && !normalized.includes('/dist/')) { try { require('child_process').execSync('npm run feedback:check 2>&1 | tail -15', { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: process.cwd() }); } catch(e) {} }"
